title: Agentic AI
summary: Build AI agents that use tools: the agent loop, tool calling, memory, routing and multi-agent patterns, MCP, and the safety controls that make them trustworthy.
outcomes: Explain what an agent is and when a plain workflow is better
Describe tools with schemas and run model tool calls safely
Build the think, act, observe loop with limits and error recovery
Manage memory and context for long tasks
Use routing, supervisor and review patterns, and understand MCP
Add permissions, approvals, budgets and tests to an agent
